云川这下彻底不能保持镇静了，眼珠子差点瞪出来，语气里满是难以置信：

“才几个月？你就已经筑基了？”

吴姜眨了眨眼，一脸茫然，他还是第一次听到“筑基”这个说法，倒有几分修仙小说的味道，忍不住问道：“筑基是什么？我不知道这个，按我们这边的说法，我现在是鬼卒境。”

吴姜解释了一下自己的修炼体系，云川点了点头，说道：“那你们走的是鬼修的体系。”

吴姜也从云川的口中，了解了他们所修的大道。

慢慢的熟悉过后，云川彻底放低了姿态，还有一丝不好意思：“吴先生勿怪啊，我从小在龙虎山长大，很少下山，接触的都是师门长辈和师兄弟，所以不知道怎么和外人打交道。”

吴姜见状，忍不住笑了：“原来如此，我还以为道长你天生高冷，不爱与人交流呢。”

吴姜这才知道，云川的师傅这次派他下山，也是存了让他历练的想法。

云川又说道：“吴先生不用叫我道长，直接叫我云川就行，云川既是我的道号，也是我的名字，我叫张云川。”

“行，那你也别叫我吴先生了，叫我吴姜就行。”吴姜爽快应道，

两人越聊越热乎，吴姜也从他口中得知，苏国维兄弟的父亲，当年曾对龙虎山有大恩，所以这次苏家遇到麻烦，苏国维才第一时间联系上了龙虎山，师门也才特意派了云川下山相助。

吴姜越发觉得这趟出来的明智了，以前他只知道地府、厉鬼，却不知道这世上还有更多不为人知的异类。

一些深山老林子里，还有修炼成妖的，不过，数量很稀少，基本不在人类世界露面。

除此之外，僵尸也是真实存在的，只是相关消息都被国家严格封锁，不让普通人知晓，以免引起恐慌。

像龙虎山、茅山这样的道家大派，都和国家有官方合作，一旦出现僵尸作乱、邪祟扰民的情况，他们都会出手相助，配合国家清除隐患。

碰到这么感兴趣的话题，吴姜也半点不觉得困，一口气开了四个多小时，直到实在憋不住，两人才进服务区解决生理问题。

Yun Chuan couldn't keep calm now, his eyes almost popped out, his tone was full of disbelief:

"It's only been a few months? You've already established a foundation?"

Wu Jiang blinked and looked confused. This was the first time he heard the term "foundation building". It sounded a bit like a novel about cultivating immortals. He couldn't help but ask: "What is foundation building? I don't know this. According to what we say here, I am now in the ghost realm."

Wu Jiang explained his cultivation system, and Yunchuan nodded and said, "Then you follow the ghost cultivation system."

Wu Jiang also learned about the great road they had built from Yunchuan's words.

After slowly getting acquainted with each other, Yun Chuan completely lowered his attitude and said with a hint of embarrassment: "Mr. Wu, don't blame me. I grew up in Longhu Mountain and rarely go down the mountain. The only people I interact with are my elders and brothers, so I don't know how to deal with outsiders."

When Wu Jiang saw this, he couldn't help but laugh: "I see, I thought you, Taoist Priest, were aloof by nature and didn't like to communicate with others."

Only then did Wu Jiang know that Yunchuan's master sent him down the mountain this time with the idea of letting him practice.

Yunchuan added: "Mr. Wu doesn't need to call me Taoist Master, just call me Yunchuan. Yunchuan is both my Taoist name and my name. My name is Zhang Yunchuan."

"Okay, then don't call me Mr. Wu, just call me Wu Jiang." Wu Jiang responded readily,

The more the two chatted, the more enthusiastic they became. Wu Jiang also learned from him that the father of the Su Guowei brothers had been very kind to Longhu Mountain. Therefore, when the Su family was in trouble this time, Su Guowei contacted Longhu Mountain immediately, and the master specially sent Yunchuan down the mountain to help.

Wu Jiang felt more and more that it was wise to go out this time. In the past, he only knew about the underworld and ghosts, but he didn't know that there were more unknown aliens in the world.

In some deep mountains and old forests, there are still people who have cultivated themselves into demons, but their numbers are very rare and they basically do not show up in the human world.

In addition, zombies are real, but the relevant information is strictly blocked by the state and is not known to ordinary people to avoid causing panic.

Taoist sects such as Longhushan and Maoshan have official cooperation with the state. Once zombies cause chaos and evil spirits disturb the people, they will help and cooperate with the state to eliminate hidden dangers.

Wu Jiang didn't feel sleepy at all when encountering such an interesting topic. He drove for more than four hours at a stretch. Until he couldn't hold it in anymore, the two of them went into the service area to solve their physical problems.
